name: skill-translator
description: Translate programming-language-specific Claude Code skills into equivalent skills for a different target language or framework. Use when someone wants to port, convert, or adapt an existing skill from one language ecosystem to another — e.g., 'make a Python version of this TypeScript skill', 'port this to Rust', 'translate this skill to Go'. Deep translation: adapts code examples, tooling, project structure, architectural patterns, and idioms — not just syntax.
